Actual genitive article and God noun jointly supply of God as the counsel qualifier; no independent Greek of preposition is printed.

20:28.sourceText: προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς καὶ παντὶ τῷ ποιμνίῳ, ἐν ᾧ ὑμᾶς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ἔθετο ἐπισκόπους, ποιμαίνειν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἣν περιεποιήσατο διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ ἰδίου.
20:28.targetText: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit made you overseers, to feed the Assembly of God that He acquired through His own blood,

groups.note: Actual ἑαυτοῖς is the second-person plural dative reflexive, rendered to yourselves. The English to expresses its real case relation, not an independent source preposition.
Actual παντί is dative all with the flock complement, rendered to all; its dative relation does not create an independently printed Greek to preposition.
Actual genitive article and God noun jointly supply of God as the Assembly qualifier, retaining the actual God name rather than a different title.

Actual second article and own adjective are both recorded masculine genitive, T-GSM/A-GSM, in the pinned functional and form analyses. The identical written forms also permit genitive neuter analysis. English His own is an adjectival/possessive rendering before blood; this link does not select an attachment or theological referent from the form ambiguity. No independent His pronoun or Son noun is printed, and the source tags are not retagged.

The Greek article with blood has no separate English counterpart beside the English His-own modifier.

20:29.sourceText: ἐγὼ οἶδα ὅτι εἰσελεύσονται μετὰ τὴν ἄφιξίν μου λύκοι βαρεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς μὴ φειδόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου,
20:29.targetText: for I have known this, that there will enter in, after my departing, grievous wolves to you, not sparing the flock,

groups.note: Actual ἄφιξιν is the arrival or departure noun, rendered departing here. Its actual noun identity is retained rather than an invented departing participle. Primary dictionary: https://www.billmounce.com/greek-dictionary/aphixis .

unmappedSource.reason: The Greek article with my departing has no separate English counterpart beside my.

The checked TR additionally writes τοῦτο after know; N1904 has no corresponding demonstrative.

20:30.sourceText: καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἀναστήσονται ἄνδρες λαλοῦντες διεστραμμένα τοῦ ἀποσπᾶν τοὺς μαθητὰς ὀπίσω ἑαυτῶν.
20:30.targetText: and there will arise men of your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

groups.note: Actual αὐτῶν is a personal intensive in of you yourselves, rendered own selves. It is not the separately written reflexive form used later in this same verse.

Actual διεστραμμένα is a perfect passive twisted participle used substantivally, rendered perverse things. The real verbal form is retained rather than inventing a separate Greek things noun or perverse adjective.
Actual genitive article and drawing-away infinitive jointly supply the purpose to draw away; the English marker remains with the actual infinitival head.

Actual ἑαυτῶν is a third-person plural genitive reflexive, rendered the plain personal English them after after. The source reflexive identity remains distinct from the earlier personal intensive αὐτῶν.

20:31.sourceText: διὸ γρηγορεῖτε, μνημονεύοντες ὅτι τριετίαν νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν οὐκ ἐπαυσάμην μετὰ δακρύων νουθετῶν ἕνα ἕκαστον.
20:31.targetText: Therefore, watch, remembering that three years, night and day, I did not cease with tears warning each one;

groups.note: Actual τριετίαν is one three-year-period noun, rendered three years; no separately printed three numeral and years noun are manufactured.

20:32.sourceText: καὶ τὰ νῦν παρατίθεμαι ὑμᾶς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ τῷ δυναμένῳ οἰκοδομῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν κληρονομίαν ἐν τοῖς ἡγιασμένοις πᾶσιν.
20:32.targetText: and now, I commend you, brothers, to God, and to the word of His grace, that is able to build up, and to give you an inheritance among all those sanctified.

groups.note: Actual article plus now forms the temporal expression, rendered now; both actual construction words are retained.
Actual genitive article and grace noun jointly supply of ... grace with His separately anchored. The bare relation remains with its actual nominal head.
Actual οἰκοδομῆσαι is the unprefixed building infinitive, rendered to build up. The checked TR uses the related prefixed ἐποικοδομῆσαι; no separate Greek up word is invented.
Actual definite article and inheritance noun are rendered an inheritance. The same real nominal head is retained while the named English wording uses an indefinite article.

unmappedSource.reason: Actual dative article and LORD title differ from the checked TR and English to-God phrase. The unlike named heads remain wholly unpaired rather than a bare article-to-to link.

The checked TR and this English wording have God; N1904 has the article and Lord title at this position.
The checked TR additionally writes a giving-recipient ὑμῖν. N1904 has no personal recipient after give; the earlier commend-you object is not silently reused across the different predicates.

20:33.sourceText: ἀργυρίου ἢ χρυσίου ἢ ἱματισμοῦ οὐδενὸς ἐπεθύμησα·
20:33.targetText: I coveted the silver or gold or clothing of no one;

groups.note: Actual οὐδενός is the genitive negative indefinite possessor, rendered of no one. No separate Greek of preposition or independently written one numeral is printed.

20:34.sourceText: αὐτοὶ γινώσκετε ὅτι ταῖς χρείαις μου καὶ τοῖς οὖσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ὑπηρέτησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὗται.
20:34.targetText: and you yourselves know that to my necessities, and to those who were with me, these hands ministered;

groups.note: Actual αὐτοί is nominative plural intensive, rendered you yourselves with the second-person knowing predicate. It is not an independently written reflexive pronoun.
Actual dative article and necessities noun jointly supply to ... necessities as the ministering complement; my remains anchored to its own actual genitive pronoun.
Actual οὖσιν is a present active being participle, rendered relative who were in the past narrative. Its actual present participial analysis is retained, not retagged as an imperfect finite verb.

20:35.sourceText: πάντα ὑπέδειξα ὑμῖν, ὅτι οὕτως κοπιῶντας δεῖ ἀντιλαμβάνεσθαι τῶν ἀσθενούντων, μνημονεύειν τε τῶν λόγων τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν Μακάριόν ἐστιν μᾶλλον διδόναι ἢ λαμβάνειν.
20:35.targetText: I showed you all things, that, thus laboring, it is necessary to partake with the ailing, to also be mindful of the words of the Lord Jesus, that He Himself said: It is more blessed to give than to receive.”

groups.note: Actual ἀντιλαμβάνεσθαι is the taking-hold or aiding infinitive, rendered to partake with by the named translation. The actual head is not a separately printed μετέχω partaking verb or with preposition. Primary dictionary: https://www.billmounce.com/greek-dictionary/antilambano .
Actual ἀσθενούντων is a substantival present weak-or-ailing participle, rendered ailing with the nominal article. It is not an independently printed sickness noun.

Actual μνημονεύειν is one remembering infinitive, rendered to also be mindful around its separate also particle. The English be belongs to this real remembering predicate, not an independently printed source copula.
Actual αὐτός is nominative intensive, rendered He Himself; no separately printed reflexive form is asserted.

20:36.sourceText: καὶ ταῦτα εἰπὼν, θεὶς τὰ γόνατα αὐτοῦ σὺν πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς προσηύξατο.
20:36.targetText: And having said these things, having bowed his knees, with them all, he prayed,

groups.note: Actual θείς is a setting or placing participle with the knees as object, rendered having bowed his knees. The knee-setting gesture belongs to that real construction, not an independently printed bowing verb.

unmappedSource.reason: The Greek article with his knees has no separate English counterpart beside his.

20:37.sourceText: ἱκανὸς δὲ κλαυθμὸς ἐγένετο πάντων, καὶ ἐπιπεσόντες ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τοῦ Παύλου κατεφίλουν αὐτόν,
20:37.targetText: and there came a great weeping to all, and having fallen on the neck of Paul, they were kissing him,

groups.note: Actual πάντων is genitive all, identifying the people’s weeping; English recasts those same people as the experience recipients to all. The actual genitive is retained rather than a fictitious dative or to preposition.
Actual genitive article and Paul name jointly supply of Paul as the neck qualifier. The actual proper-name head remains with its case relation.
